text: I'm drawing my living room. Wall first: a faint orange rectangle in the background, 780 by 330, at 400,175, named Wall.
Floor: light brown rectangle zone, 780 x 150, centered at 400,415. Call it Floor.
Window on the left wall, a light cyan rectangle 160 by 110 at 150,140 with a white outline, named Window
the sofa: big green rectangle, 220 wide and 70 tall, at 330,380 - Sofa
armrests please: green rectangles 30 by 60, ArmL at 190,385 and another green 30 by 60 rectangle ArmR at 470,385
Put Sofa, ArmL and ArmR together in a group called Couch.
Hang a clock: medium white circle at 520,110, label it "12", name Clock
Picture frame next to the clock, a gold rectangle 90 by 70 at 360,130, Frame
is the frame left of the clock?
Floor lamp: brown rectangle, 10 wide 150 tall, at 580,340, name LampPole
yellow triangle for the shade, small, at 580,252, LampShade
lamp group = LampPole + LampShade, call it FloorLamp
TV: black rectangle 150 by 90 at 700,300, named Tv
a brown stand under it: rectangle 100 by 40 at 700,385, TvStand
oval rug on the floor, light red, 260 by 50, at 330,455, name it Rug
little gray cat on the floor: small gray oval at 525,445, CatBody
its head is a tiny gray circle at 568,432, called CatHead
group the cat: CatBody and CatHead as Whiskers
Potted plant in the corner: small brown square at 60,420 named Pot
and a medium green star 6 px above the pot for the leaves, Leaves
How many rectangles do I have?
